title: Pre Normalization Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: Source/destination well should be in column
Qubit reading should be in column
Water added to final plate depending on csv
DNA added to final plate depending on csv

steps.title: Create transfer CSV
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that includes a header in row 1; place source/destination well identifiers in column 1; place Qubit readings in column 3; determine the transfer volume for each well based on its Qubit reading.

steps.title: Add water to final plate
steps.instruction: Add water to each well of the final plate according to the volumes specified in the CSV.

steps.title: Add DNA to final plate
steps.instruction: Add DNA to each well of the final plate according to the volumes specified in the CSV.
